goals.description: Shelter highest-need clients without collapsing equity

blue_r1.what: First-come first-served: fill all 40 beds from head of queue
blue_r1.rationale: Naive FCFS ignores equity priority mix.

red_r1.description: Capacity surge: 58 arrivals; FCFS starves disability/family priority — equity collapses
red_r1.rationale: Hard equity floor breached under FCFS during surge.

blue_r2.what: Patch: priority bands (family/disability) + hotel vouchers for overflow within $12k
blue_r2.rationale: Restores equity floor and keeps physical capacity honest.

red_r2.rationale: Budget pressure without re-breaking equity if bands hold.

blue_r3.what: Final: lock priority bands + voucher cap alerts at 80% spend

red_r3.description: Attempt to game priority with false documentation — checklist catch

baseline: ONE-SHOT BASELINE: Fill beds FCFS tonight; it is fair by arrival time and maximizes throughput. Vouchers later if needed. Confidence: high. (Misses equity floor under surge.)

memo.title: Recommend priority-band allocation + capped vouchers
memo.recommended_reason: FCFS dies on equity. Survivor uses priority bands and voucher spend inside $12k.
memo.kill_shots: Red surge showed FCFS drops equity below 0.70 while overstating capacity honesty.
memo.open_risks: Voucher burn rate; documentation fraud attempts.
memo.dissent: Queue-order advocates call priority unfair; Arbiter enforces hard equity constraint.
